title: Pokémon Serperior 006/088 Rare Reverse Holo Paradox Rift 160 HP Stage 2 2023
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a Pokémon Serperior card from the Paradox Rift set, with a rare reverse holo finish. This Stage 2 Grass-type Pokémon has 160 HP and is illustrated by Kodama. Manufactured by Nintendo in 2023, this English-language card is a sought-after collectible for Pokémon TCG enthusiasts. Its unique features make it a valuable addition to any card collection, especially for fans of the Serperior character and the Pokémon franchise.
